entities.name: Khwarezmian Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Khwarezmian Empire, a political institution in Mongolia during Mongol Empire of Genghis Khan (1206–1260). Grew from Temüjin proclaimed Genghis Khan ('Universal Ruler') at the kurultai and Rise of Genghis Khan. Led to the emergence of Mongol Conquests.
